thread:
Dana: Vendor sent updated booking notice — ETA 2026-04-18. They want to split 20 units: 8 by air (urgent) + 12 by sea. Price note: +5% surcharge for air before Apr 20. Need decision: accept surge or wait and keep original price?
Samir: Can you paste the vendor quote and AWB numbers?
Dana: Quote ref INV-9987. AWB (urgent tranche) 123-45678901. Vendor text: 'urgent slot surcharge 5% if ship before Apr 20'. PDF attached in vendor portal.
Marie: We should push back — that 5% kills margin on Dedicated for the demo fleet. How many H100s are in the critical list?
Dana: 20 total across EU pool, 8 needed in next 2 weeks for customer demos and internal benchmarks.
Pedro: Heads up — earlier batch from same vendor returned 2 DOA at the FRA depot. Vendor proposes RMA -> send 2 refurb spares instead of new replacements. That's not what we agreed.
Anna: Do we have depot photos or serials for the DOA units?
Pedro: Yes — ser# H100-EL-00123 and H100-EL-00456. Depot report attached to the RMA (thermal damage in transit, claimed by carrier).
Samir: If they ship refurb, we require warranty parity and SLA credits. We should ask for 12mo warranty on any refurb + freight credit until replaced with new units.
Dana: Counter-proposal draft: accept urgent air split for 8 units at +5% surcharge conditional on: new replacements (not refurb) for the 2 DOA within 30 days; vendor covers RMA return labels, customs brokerage, and depot handling fees; 12-month warranty parity; 5-unit regional spare pool at vendor depot for 60 days at no charge; HS code / customs paperwork provided before handover.
Marie: Add a penalty clause: if replacements exceed 30 days, vendor pays freight credit 1.5% of the line-item value per week late, capped at 10%.
ops-bot: FYI — recent DOA trend: incidents on 2026-02-03, 2026-02-17, 2026-03-05. Reliability metric dropped from 0.98 -> 0.92 last 30d.
Pedro: Bot looks right. Escalate to procurement — need root-cause: packaging, palletization, or carrier damage pattern.
Samir: I'll draft formal vendor message with RMA specifics and penalty language.
Dana: Draft pasted below:
```text
We accept urgent air split for 8 units at +5% surcharge conditional on:
- New replacements for DOA units (no refurb), shipped within 30 days
- Vendor covers RMA return labels, customs brokerage, and depot handling fees
- 12-month warranty parity for any replacement/refurb
- 5-unit regional spare pool held for 60 days at vendor depot (no charge)
- Provide HS code and CN22/23 paperwork prior to handover
```
Marie: Looks good. Also ask them for pallet photos from origin and packing spec (corner protectors, straps, foam) before shipping.
Lily: Procurement sign-off here. I'll fast-track approval for the +5% on the urgent tranche if vendor signs the PO amendment with the clauses above. Finance will accept offset by SLA credits if replacements miss the timeline.
Pedro: Vendor replied in portal: 'We can confirm new replacements for DOA units and will process RMA with AWBs; spare pool is possible but requires a deposit.'
Anna: What's the requested deposit?
Pedro: They asked for 10% of unit list price held for 60 days. That's a non-starter for us.
Marie: Counter: consignment arrangement — vendor holds 5 spares on consignment with no upfront payment for 60 days; invoiced only if spares are pulled.
Samir: If vendor declines consignment, we should route critical orders to alternate vendor list for EU edge.
Dana: Vendor response to consignment ask: 'Agree to consignment for 60 days pending KYC and proof of storage capability; 2-week onboarding timeline required.'
Lily: I'll push KYC now and can accelerate legal SOW for consignment terms.
Anna: Ops can reserve rack slots at FRA depot for 5 units. Need to include handling SLA in the SOW (24h swap SLA once AWB clears).
ops-bot: Action items created — procurement KYC (Lily), ops reserve FRA pallet space (Anna), Samir finalize penalty clause, Dana to update PO amendment. Reminder set for 3 days.
Pedro: Logging AWB from the earlier DOA batch: AWB 890-12345678 — arrived 2026-03-05 and was held by customs due to CN23 mismatch.
Samir: I'll add HS code 8471.80 to the PO and share with our customs broker to prevent repeat holds.
Dana: Also ensure serial-to-node mapping is captured — replacements must map to the same cluster tags to avoid inventory drift.
Marie: Once vendor signs amendment, ops: please add a small runbook for RMA intake and QC on arrival (photo + thermal test + staging checklist).
Anna: Will do. I'll attach the runbook to the SOW.
Dana: OK — proceeding with signed PO amendment once procurement/KYC done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Samir: Good plan.
Lily: Signed off — moving to vendor.
ops-bot: Thread closed (auto) — follow-ups in procurement@redwood if needed. :white_check_mark:
